## Contribution Scope

massCode accepts external pull requests only for localizations and new syntax highlighting languages. All other external pull requests will be closed.

- To report a bug, please [open an issue](https://github.com/massCodeIO/massCode/issues/new/choose).
- For feature requests and ideas, please use [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/massCodeIO/massCode/discussions).

See our [contribution policy](https://github.com/massCodeIO/massCode/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md) for details.

## Type of Change

- [ ] Add or improve localizations
- [ ] Add a new syntax highlighting language

## Description

Describe what you changed and how you verified it.
